|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">スノートルーパーのエリート士官。帝国陸軍の士官の常として、反乱軍の戦法には精通している。歩兵とAT-ATを連係させる要として働く。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Snowtrooper Officer.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Snowtroopers deploy for 1 less at the same location. Your troopers may move as a react to the same Hoth location as the officer.

'''Lore:'''
An elite Snowtrooper officer. Like other Imperial Army officers, he is well versed in Rebel tactics. He serves as the link between the infantry and the AT-ATs.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置 where the English says site.
